_comment: Hoodrich supply contacts. These are who you buy BULK from; bulk cannot be sold until it
has been cut and bagged (wheel > Cut).
The DOCK WORKER is the one-stop shop: an empty 'drugs' list means the whole catalogue, so
any product you add to drugs.json shows up there automatically. He charges full price.
Every gang contact carries only what that gang moves, but sells it at a real discount.
Contacts have no fixed map position on purpose. Calling one arranges a meet at a spot
chosen near you at runtime and blips it, so nothing here depends on hardcoded coordinates.
gangId           ties the contact to a gang. A gang at war with your crew will not deal
with you at any price. Running with them is 10% off; rep 100+ is 5% off.
models           ped models tried IN ORDER. The first actually present in your install is
used, so a wrong or DLC-only name costs flavour, not the feature.
priceMultiplier  applied to the wholesale price. Below 1.0 is a better deal.
minRank          player rank index 0-4 (Pee-Wee, Soldier, Enforcer, Shotcaller, OG)
openHour/closeHour  operating hours, 0-24. Wraps midnight when open > close.
